body: Process tree on Windows via one CreateToolhelp32Snapshot through windows-sys 0.61 (already in Cargo.lock via tokio, cfg(windows) only, features Win32_Foundation + Win32_System_Diagnostics_ToolHelp); Linux walks /proc/<pid>/stat; other OS returns no chain (top-level, env CLAUDE_PID as own pid). Measured: snapshot 7 ms median vs PowerShell Get-CimInstance 271 ms. Alternative: sysinfo crate (heavy, refreshes far more than ppid+name) or shelling out (too slow for the 1.5 s SessionEnd budget).

Own claude = nearest claude-named ancestor of the hook (the hook is always spawned by its own session), falling back to the ancestor whose pid == CLAUDE_PID, then to CLAUDE_PID; parent = next claude-named ancestor above it. Alternative: skip only the ancestor whose pid == CLAUDE_PID (TASK-003 wording) - identical when CLAUDE_PID is right, reports the session itself as parent when CLAUDE_PID is stale (the TASK-003 synthetic bug).

One POST timeout of 500 ms for every event. Measured with the reference debug build: a closed local port costs the full timeout on Windows (SYN retried after RST), SessionEnd against a silent or absent hub 526-538 ms wall, answering hub 18-39 ms. Alternative: 500 ms for SessionEnd and 1 s for the rest (every prompt would wait 1 s whenever the hub is stopped).

Device config (hub hook addr, shared secret, host override) comes from process env first, then <home>/.cctg/device.env read with dotenvy::from_path_iter into memory, never set_var; module crate::device, reused by TASK-013 together with host_name and canonical_cwd. Alternative: CCTG_* user environment variables only (every Bash tool call and every child of claude would carry the secret in its env).

SubagentStop with a non-empty agent_type is dropped as internal when neither agent-<id>.jsonl nor agent-<id>.meta.json exists next to agent_transcript_path (14/14 internal events of TASK-003 have neither, the real Explore has both). Covers the --agent session-name case on the device, without SubagentStart state. Alternative: send the session's --agent name in SessionStart (new wire field) and filter in hub registry against seen SubagentStart (touches registry.rs, relies on SubagentStart that hooks installed mid-session miss).

Settings snippet (docs/hook-settings.json) registers the handback matcher on PostToolUse only; the binary accepts PreToolUse and PostToolUse alike. Alternative: both (every report reaches the hub twice under different event ids; PreToolUse also blocks the subagent before its tool runs).

Shell-form commands 'cctg hook <Event>' in the snippet. Alternative: exec form (command 'cctg' + args) - no Git Bash in the chain and faster, but whether exec form resolves 'cctg' to cctg.exe via PATH on Windows is not verified.

First reference build passed the Probe (with &dyn Fn fields, not Sync) across an .await inside a tokio::spawn'ed future: E0277. Fixed by building the POST in a sync helper (build_here) so the probe never lives across an await.

First hook_cli run asserted < 1.2 s for SessionStart against a closed port while SessionStart had a 1 s timeout; flaked under parallel load because Windows retries the refused connect until the timeout. Led to the single 500 ms timeout.

Short POST timeout (300 ms) only for UserPromptSubmit; Stop, SubagentStart/Stop, handback and lifecycle keep 500 ms. Alternative rejected: PLAN_V2 300 ms for all blocking events, because Stop/SubagentStop/handback carry report text that a slow Tailscale link would lose, while only UserPromptSubmit holds the user visibly.

Own-process rule: a node ancestor matching CLAUDE_PID and nearer than the first named claude wins; any other name keeps the nearest claude. Alternative rejected: let any CLAUDE_PID-matching nearer ancestor win (a stale pid reused by a shell would move the own pid; mutation M2 shows the test catching it).

The supplied Bash hash verifier could not start in the Windows sandbox because Git Bash CreateFileMapping failed with Win32 error 5. Used an equivalent BOM-free PowerShell SHA-256 verifier under scratch instead.

Trim trailing ASCII whitespace from the fixture before enumerating truncated JSON prefixes in the broken-input unit test. Alternative rejected: change runtime parsing or weaken the process-tree assertion; CRLF creates two complete valid prefixes on Windows, so normalizing only the test input preserves the intended assertion.

Rated the name-only claude.exe parent rule as major (NEEDS_WORK) instead of accepting it as the plan's known pid-reuse risk: Claude Desktop runs as claude.exe (13 Electron processes on the dev host) and bundles Claude Code 2.1.280, so a Desktop-hosted or reused-pid ancestor yields parent_claude_pid Some and the hub drops the topic. Alternative rejected: PASS with a note, because the failure is silent (no topic) and the fix is local to proctree.

Windows parent validation uses the full image path plus strict creation-time ancestry. Claude Desktop is denied only for case-insensitive path markers \WindowsApps\Claude_ and \AnthropicClaude\; the bundled CLI under \Claude\claude-code\ remains valid. Alternative rejected: allow only known CLI install directories, which would reject standalone CLI installations.

SubagentStart applies the empty-or-whitespace agent_type filter, but not the SubagentStop file-existence filter because observed Start payloads lack agent_transcript_path and files are asynchronous. Alternative rejected: require files at Start, which drops valid subagents.

Linux target verification could not run offline because the target dependency graph needs uncached openssl-probe; the host also has no x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu target installed. No source change was made for this tooling limitation.

Simulating a nested run live by launching a fake claude.exe through `env ...` or `bash -c '<single command>'` from the Git Bash tool shell produced parent_claude_pid null: the MSYS process that exec'd the native child had already exited, so the verified chain stopped there (the known TASK-003 wrapper hole, not the fixer's creation-time check). Launching the fake claude directly from the tool shell kept the chain intact and the hook reported the real session claude as parent.
